card.title: Head of Production, Supply Chain & Continuous Improvement
card.description:
At Alloy Precision Technologies, we unite advanced manufacturing with hands-on mastery to deliver for our customers—and create meaningful growth for our people. Lead the engine room of our business and amplify impact across operations.

**Your mission**
----------------

* Own the production, supply chain, maintenance, planning, and warehouse ecosystem—drive flow, reliability, and cost discipline.
* Build systems that make performance visible: schedule adherence, on-time delivery, throughput, and quality.
* Elevate safety and environmental performance through visible leadership and clear standards.
* Institutionalize lean practices and business process improvements that reduce waste and improve profitability.
* Publish clear, actionable reports that inform decisions across the organization.
* Set annual targets and programs for manufacturing, service, and distribution that align with strategy.
* Ensure outcomes meet customer expectations and comply with AS9100 and applicable regulations.
* Travel domestically and internationally as required to support operations and partner engagements.
* Take on additional priorities as assigned by the President and Chief Executive Officer.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Plan, coordinate, and control day-to-day operations across all manufacturing services.
* Diagnose and resolve production delays and constraints via structured problem solving.
* Strengthen cross-functional communication to align objectives and remove friction.
* Coach and mentor leaders; cultivate a culture of empowerment, accountability, and teamwork.

**Team leadership**
-------------------

* Directly lead group leaders, supply chain, and production planning; adapt org structure as needs evolve.
* Execute people processes in accordance with APT policies and all applicable laws: hiring, training, work assignment, performance management, recognition, discipline, issue resolution, and career growth.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* BS in Operations Management, Industrial Management, Industrial Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.
* 10+ years in manufacturing management; exposure to precision welding (TIG, laser, brazing, soldering), CNC/manual machining, and light assembly is beneficial.
* Advanced skills with Microsoft Office; experience with databases/ERP (e.g., Visual Manufacturing) and establishing labor standards for cost models is advantageous.
* High-energy, results-driven leadership with exceptional interpersonal skills; able to influence at every level.
* Strategic, proactive, and persistent; effective at managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
* Flexible, resilient, and growth-oriented within an evolving culture; dedicated to excellence and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated lean manufacturing capability required; Six Sigma background is a plus.

card.description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. 
 
DESCRIPTION: 
As a Sr. Manager, Manufacturing Engineering at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will guide and support engineering teams to drive operational excellence and innovation across our manufacturing facilities. You will provide strategic direction and technical leadership for manufacturing processes, automation initiatives, and continuous improvement projects while ensuring compliance with quality and regulatory requirements. Working collaboratively with cross-functional teams, you'll optimize production efficiency, implement new technologies, and deliver solutions that enable our mission of making the world healthier, cleaner and safer. 
 
REQUIREMENTS: 

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in regulated manufacturing environments (pharmaceutical, medical device, or related industries)
* Preferred Fields of Study: Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, Chemical) or related technical field. Strong focus on Automation required.
* Industry certifications in Six Sigma, PMP, or related areas are beneficial
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing technical teams and facilitating organizational change
* Demonstrated success implementing automation, digitalization and continuous improvement initiatives
* Strong understanding of cGMP, ISO standards and regulatory compliance requirements
* Experience with new product introductions, technology transfers and process validation
* Expertise in lean manufacturing principles, Six Sigma methodology and practical process improvements (PPI)
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategic plans aligned with business objectives
* Strong project management skills and experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities with data-driven decision making
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to engage stakeholders at all levels
* Proficiency with manufacturing systems, automation platforms and quality tools
* Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
* Experience with capital project planning, budgeting and resource allocation

* **Relocation:** Relocation assistance is not available for this position.
* **Work Authorization:** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer-sponsored work authorization.
* **Pre-Employment Screening:** Employment is contingent upon successful completion of all applicable pre-employment requirements, including a background check and drug screening, in accordance with company policy and applicable law.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range estimated for this position based in New Jersey is $155,100.00–$232,650.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

card.title: Plant Manager - Louisville
card.description:
**Plant Manager**

**Who we are:** 
Atkore is forging a future where our employees, customers, suppliers, shareholders, and communities are building better together – a future focused on serving the customer and powering and protecting the world.

With a global network of manufacturing and distribution facilities, Atkore is a leading provider of electrical, safety and infrastructure solutions.

 

**Who we are looking for:** 
We are currently looking for a Plant Manager to be based out of Louisville, KY. Reporting to the Vice President Operations, this person will be responsible for directing and managing plant operations for extrusion processing, maintenance, quality, and shipping/receiving. This position will coordinate plant activities through the planning with departmental managers to ensure the total manufacturing objectives are accomplished in a safe, timely and cost-effective manner.

The ideal candidate will have a Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or a minimum of 5 years plant/general management experience in a manufacturing environment or prior success as a Plant Manager or equivalent position at Atkore. Experience in lean manufacturing or business system-based company is a requirement.

**What you’ll do:**

* Provide direction, development and leadership for the facility and share best practices with other Plant Managers in running a safe, productive, cost-effective plant
* Establish and monitor overall plant performance for production and quality standards.
* Implement cost effective systems of control over capital, operating expenditures, manpower, wages and salaries.
* Participate in regular P&L reviews to ensure that budgets are met; develops and implements programs for optimal equipment utilization, equipment maintenance, and labor and material costs
* Control and minimize labor overtime, premium freight and repair expenses.
* Provide leadership and training to accomplish the company goals and objectives.
* Maintain existing plant facilities and equipment; replace or make adjustments to plant facilities and equipment when necessary.
* Manage capital asset maintenance.
* Implement and maintain preventative maintenance programs.
* Provide Safety and Health direction and support to personnel; ensures compliance with OSHA and environmental regulations.
* Incorporate shop floor organization and plant cleanliness among plant personnel.
* Demonstrate and promote our key Atkore values of Accountability Teamwork, Integrity, Respect, and Excellence, through actions and decisions.

**What you’ll bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or a minimum of 5 years plant/general management experience in a manufacturing environment or prior success as a Plant Manager or equivalent position at Atkore.
* Working knowledge of budgets and financial statements.
* Background with manufacturing methods, process improvement programs and procedures required.
* Advanced knowledge and experience of PVC Water pipe extrusion process preferred.
* Ability to implement Lean Manufacturing practices and drive continuous improvement.
* Six Sigma / Project Management experience.
* Excellent written and communications skills
* Computer literate. Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Excel and PowerPoint.
* Proven experience as a mentor/developmental manager for employees
* Available to occasionally work off shift to provide training and facilitate continuous improvement initiatives to all production shifts.
* Ability to work both as a member of a team, a team leader or as an individual contributor.
* Experience managing in a matrixed, mid-to-large organization
* All associates must embrace and foster and environment that supports our core values of Integrity, Respect, Excellence, Teamwork and Accountability.

 

**Within 3 months, you’ll:**

* Complete your Atkore Immersion and training requirements.
* Understand how your job will help deliver Atkore’s strategy.
* Gain an understanding of your team.
* Have developed relationships with the key stakeholders for this role.
* Be well-versed in Atkore’s Business System and the importance of your role to daily operations.

 

**Within 6 months, you’ll:**

* Maintain and be accountable for KPI visual reporting while actively participating in Lean Daily Management activities, including GEMBA walks.
* Create and modify standardized work and ensure consistent application by all team members.
* Hire talent into your organization, coach and manage performance of your team members and compensation management responsibilities for direct reports.
* Identify ways to strengthen the team’s commitment to Atkore’s core values of Accountability, Teamwork, Integrity, Respect and Excellence.

 

**Within 12 months, you’ll:**

* Be managing an efficient plant and team that delivers Atkore’s strategy.
* Have meaningful performance conversations with your direct reports.
* Be able to resolve any issues quickly and safely.

Atkore is a seven-time Great Place to Work© certified company and a three-time Top Workplaces USA award winner! We’re committed to creating an engaged and aligned workforce driven by a collaborative culture. We consistently live the Atkore mission, strategic priorities, and behaviors, consistent with our core values.

**Join our team and align yourself with an industry leader!**

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay for this position is $128,080 - $176,110. Placement in the range depends on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, relevant experience, skills, seniority, performance, shift, travel requirements, and business or organizational needs and may change over time. Other compensation may include, but not limited to, overtime, shift differentials, bonuses, commissions, stock, and other incentives.

Benefits available include:

* Medical, vision, and dental insurance
* Life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance
* 401k
* Paid Time Off
* Paid holidays
* Any leave required under federal, state, or local law

Benefits are subject to vesting and eligibility requirements.

Applications are being accepted on an ongoing basis.

card.title: Production Director
card.description:
The Production Director leads all signage manufacturing operations, including fabrication, wide-format printing, finishing, assembly, production quality and installation. This leader is accountable for meeting customer commitments, maximizing production capacity, controlling costs, and achieving departmental financial objectives. 
This is a high-accountability leadership role requiring operational expertise, financial discipline, and a growth mindset. The Director will build a high-performing team, establish clear expectations, improve productivity, eliminate bottlenecks, and ensure the department can scale efficiently as Strategic Factory grows. 
The objective is to deliver exceptional quality, flawless execution, and profitable growth through strong leadership, disciplined processes, and measurable results. 
Essential Responsibilities1. Financial Performance and Profitability

* Own departmental performance against revenue, gross margin, labor, material, and profitability targets.
* Monitor job costing, estimated versus actual labor, material usage, overtime, waste, and rework to protect margins.
* Establish cost controls and identify opportunities to improve productivity, reduce expenses, and increase throughput.
* Align staffing, equipment, purchasing, and production capacity with work orders, forecasts, and company growth objectives.
* Partner with the VP of Signage, Finance, Sales, and Project Management to ensure production decisions support company-wide financial goals.

2. Production Leadership and Execution

* Lead all daily signage production operations, including fabricated signs, channel letters, dimensional signage, wide-format printing, finishing, and assembly.
* Own production scheduling, workflow, capacity planning, and on-time completion.
* Establish clear priorities, deadlines, and ownership across production teams.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Project Management, Purchasing, and Installation to ensure projects move efficiently from order to completion.
* Identify constraints early, resolve production issues quickly, and maintain visibility into work in progress, material availability, and equipment utilization.
* Ensure production commitments are realistic, communicated, and consistently achieved.

3. Leadership and Accountability

* Build and develop a high-performing team focused on urgency, quality, teamwork, and results.
* Establish clear roles, measurable expectations, and accountability for supervisors and production employees.
* Hold team leaders accountable for schedules, staffing, productivity, quality, safety, and financial performance.
* Coach and develop supervisors to solve problems, make decisions, and own their results rather than relying on constant intervention.
* Address performance issues promptly, recognize strong performance, and ensure appropriate training and staffing.
* Foster a positive, high-energy culture that values continuous improvement, direct communication, and follow-through.
* Leadership standard: Set expectations, provide the tools to succeed, measure results, coach consistently, and hold people accountable.

4. Quality and Customer Satisfaction

* Establish quality standards for all fabricated, printed, and finished signage.
* Ensure work meets approved artwork, engineering specifications, material requirements, and customer expectations.
* Track defects, rework, scrap, and customer complaints; implement corrective actions to prevent recurring problems.
* Partner with Project Management and Installation to resolve issues and protect customer commitments.
* Promote a customer-first mindset in which quality, communication, and on-time delivery drive retention and future revenue.

5. Operational Excellence and Growth

* Continuously improve workflows, production methods, standard operating procedures, and equipment utilization.
* Eliminate bottlenecks, unnecessary handling, downtime, waste, and inefficient labor practices.
* Develop a scalable production plan aligned with sales forecasts and annual revenue goals.
* Identify staffing, equipment, facility, and technology investments needed to support growth, with clear financial justification.
* Make disciplined in-house versus outsourcing decisions based on cost, capacity, quality, and delivery.
* Use production data and performance scorecards to identify trends, assign corrective actions, and measure results.

6. Materials, Equipment, and Safety

* Manage material planning, inventory accuracy, purchasing coordination, and supplier performance.
* Control material waste and ensure supplies are available to meet production schedules without unnecessary inventory.
* Oversee preventive maintenance and ensure equipment is operated and maintained properly.
* Maintain a safe, organized production environment and enforce company safety policies and applicable OSHA requirements.
* Ensure required training, maintenance records, and safety procedures are consistently maintained.

7. Communication and Cross-Functional Leadership

* Provide regular reporting on financial performance, production schedules, capacity, staffing, quality, and operational risks.
* Communicate schedule changes, material shortages, and customer delivery risks proactively.
* Work collaboratively with Sales, Engineering, Project Management, Purchasing, and Installation to achieve company objectives.
* Support leadership decisions, communicate priorities consistently, and focus on solutions rather than excuses.

The Director will be evaluated against established company targets, including:

* Financial: Revenue achievement, gross margin, labor costs, and departmental profitability.
* Execution: On-time delivery, schedule adherence, throughput, and production cycle time.
* Quality: Rework, scrap, defects, and customer complaints.
* Productivity: Labor efficiency, overtime, equipment utilization, and capacity.
* Growth: Ability to increase production volume while controlling costs and maintaining quality.
* Leadership: Staffing, employee development, accountability, and performance improvement.
* Operational discipline: Material waste, inventory accuracy, safety, and completion of improvement initiatives.
 
* **Requirements**

 

* 7-10 years of progressive experience in sign manufacturing, fabrication, wide-format printing, or a related production environment.
* At least 5 years of leadership experience managing production teams and preferably multiple production functions.
* Demonstrated experience with fabricated and printed signage, production scheduling, workflow management, and quality control.
* Proven ability to manage job costs, labor, materials, capacity, and profitability.
* Track record of improving productivity, quality, on-time delivery, and financial results.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Experience with ERP/MIS systems, production reporting, and performance metrics.
* Knowledge of equipment maintenance, workplace safety, and manufacturing best practices.
* Relevant degree preferred; equivalent experience and demonstrated results will be considered.

card.description:

The Director partners with Operations, Finance, and business leaders to improve safety, quality, productivity, capacity, and flexibility across the manufacturing network.

Bridging power from sources to pathways to touchpoints, Legrand's Electrical Infrastructure division combines innovation and quality to provide leading solutions for an evolving energy landscape. Our expertly designed products enable customers to confidently address the complex needs and challenges of electrification, while enhancing everyday experiences like plugging in, switching on, and staying connected. Committed to best-in-class service at every stage, we act as a trusted partner for our customers to ensure each project's success and their continued satisfaction. Legrand's Electrical Infrastructure division includes the following brands and product lines: Girtz, Avtron, Power Bus Way, Cablofil, Connectrac, Wiremold and Pass & Seymour.

Legrand, North & Central America offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as distinctive benefits like a high employer 401K match, paid time off (PTO) and holiday pay, short-term and long-term disability benefit plans, above-benchmark paid maternity and parental leave, bonus opportunities in accordance with the Company's incentive plans, paid time off to volunteer, and an active/growing Employee Resource Group network. For more information, visit legrand.us.

**At a Glance**

**Legrand**
has an exciting opportunity for a
**Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering**
to join the
**Electrical Infrastructure division.**
This leader identifies, develops, industrializes, and scales manufacturing processes, automation, autonomation, equipment, and digital capabilities that improve safety, quality, service, productivity, capacity, and flexibility across the manufacturing network.

The Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering advises, develops, and executes operational business strategies with the VP of Operations and EI division Leadership Team in support of EI growth and financial goals. Those strategies include footprint and capacity expansion, factory roles, insourcing/outsourcing, operating constraints, and growth enablement into a multiyear manufacturing technology roadmap. The role provides technical leadership for significant manufacturing investments, establishes common engineering and equipment standards, and ensures solutions are economically justified, successfully industrialized, and deliver sustained operating and financial results.

The Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering is expected to determine when advanced technology creates differentiated value and when a simpler process, equipment, maintenance, sourcing, or product solution is more appropriate.

This position leads a focused technical organization that works through plant resources, internal partners, equipment suppliers, and qualified integrators.

**What Will You Do?**

**Manufacturing Technology Strategy**

* Develop and maintain a multiyear advanced manufacturing roadmap aligned with business strategy, factory roles, product requirements, capacity needs, and footprint plans.
* Evaluate and deploy appropriate manufacturing technologies, including automation, autonomation, robotics, machine vision, controls, advanced tooling, and digital manufacturing systems.
* Identify manufacturing capabilities the division should protect, build, standardize, modernize, source externally, or retire.
* Adapt technology strategies to differences in product complexity, volume, mix, demand stability, and operating model.

* Build and prioritize a network-wide portfolio of advanced manufacturing, automation, and equipment-modernization opportunities.
* Define the operating loss or constraint being addressed, credible alternatives, expected business impact, investment requirement, lifecycle cost, risk, payback, and sustainment requirements.
* Determine when technology creates differentiated value and when process redesign, tooling, equipment refurbishment, maintenance improvement, outsourcing, product redesign, or another solution is more appropriate.
* Serve as the division's technical authority for significant manufacturing technology and equipment investments.
* Support footprint, make-versus-buy, capacity, and capital-allocation decisions with clear technical facts and alternatives.
* Lead the division governance process for manufacturing capital planning and deployment, providing consolidated visibility to investment requirements, approvals, timing, expenditure, implementation risk, and expected benefits.
* Partner with Operations, business General Managers, and Finance to develop and maintain a prioritized multi-year manufacturing plan.
* Monitor the deployment of approved manufacturing investments and escalate material risks involving scope, cost, schedule, technical performance, plant readiness, or benefit realization.

**Technical Industrialization and Standards**

* Establish standards for manufacturing equipment, automation, controls, tooling, data connectivity, safety, maintainability, and industrialization.
* Lead technical reviews of equipment specifications, process concepts, integrator selection, designs, risk assessments, acceptance testing, process capability, documentation, training, and critical spares.
* Ensure new processes incorporate quality at source, error-proofing, equipment reliability, operator safety, cybersecurity, and appropriate performance visibility.
* Establish preferred technology platforms, reusable equipment concepts, and qualified supplier and integrator networks where standardization creates value.

**Deployment and Sustainable Results**

* Lead the technical delivery of selected high-value, high-risk, or highly replicable manufacturing initiatives.
* Define when central AME involvement is required and when plant teams can execute within established standards.
* Establish clear ownership for technical development, plant readiness, commissioning, production ramp, and ongoing sustainment.
* Transfer solutions to plant ownership after safety, capability, reliability, training, documentation, maintenance, and performance requirements have been met.
* Conduct post-implementation reviews to verify that operating and financial benefits are achieved and sustained.
* Capture lessons learned and creates replication methods for proven solutions.

**Organization and Capability Development**

* Build and develop a high-performance advanced manufacturing engineering team with the technical depth required to support the division's strategy.
* Define which capabilities should be retained internally and which should be accessed through plants, internal partners, equipment suppliers, engineering firms, or system integrators.
* Establish expectations for supplier and integrator performance, documentation, intellectual property, lifecycle support, and reuse of developed solutions.
* Develop plant technical capability to minimize long-term dependence on central resources or external partners.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical field.

**Experience:**

* At least 10 years of progressive experience in advanced manufacturing engineering, automation, process engineering, or industrialization, including five years leading technical teams or multisite programs.
* Demonstrated experience in automation, robotics, autonomation, controls, machine vision, advanced tooling, or manufacturing data systems.
* Experience with equipment specifications, integrator management, design reviews, acceptance testing, commissioning, capability validation, and production handoff.
* Broad manufacturing-process knowledge and experience in both high-mix and higher-volume environments.
* Proven record of turning manufacturing technology investments into sustained operating and financial results.

**Skills/Knowledge/Abilities:**

* Strong understanding of capital economics, lifecycle cost, capacity analysis, labor impact, and benefit realization.
* Ability to translate operating losses and business requirements into prioritized technical opportunities.
* Ability to determine when advanced technology is appropriate and when a simpler operational solution will create greater value.
* Ability to translate technical complexity into clear business decisions and influence across a matrixed organization.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Finance, Product Engineering, Quality, EHS, HR, IT, Supply Chain, Lean, and PMO teams.
* Strong supplier, equipment manufacturer, and system-integrator management capabilities.
* Ability to balance enterprise standardization with legitimate differences across products, processes, plants, and operating models.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical professionals, develop organizational capability, and operate effectively across multiple businesses and manufacturing locations.

card.title: Staff Industrial Engineer, Supply Chain Material Flow
card.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE JOB

 Anduril’s Supply Chain team is seeking a Staff Industrial Engineer to join us. Working with a global network of suppliers, to support a global manufacturing platform takes people who are willing to work hard and find ways to win. As an Staff Industrial Engineer, you will have the responsibility to optimize Anduril’s supply chain's warehousing and material flow operations for best-in-class quality, reliability, speed, and asset utilization, all while meeting critical customer deployment and internal development timelines. Executing on this responsibility will entail active collaboration with other Anduril teams, including but not limited to Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, and Business Operations.

The right person for this role can demonstrate past holistic ownership on solving operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. This person will be flexible to provide support wherever needed to ensure products are built and shipped under stringent quality standards. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 
 Passionately work across multiple programs from development to full rate production to scale best-in-class solutions to align with maturity of manufacturing process

 Proactively identify imbalances and bottlenecks caused by inventory processes, line layouts, parts shortages, staffing shortages, and other production constraints; flag constraints with the appropriate owners across Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Quality and drive to resolution

 Own the metrics, KPIs, and reporting associated with monitoring production line health and efficiency, such as cycle time, throughput rate, capacity, utilization, process non-conformities, and inventory accuracy.

 Time studies of current and developing processes to ensure efficiency across warehouse and operations.

 Develop processes to optimize workplans for highly variable demands across multiple sites.

 Translate tools and reports into actionable tasks that impact the health of warehouse operations across a plethora of processes and sites.

 Produce and maintain tools to increase accuracy of work demand for new facilities and maturing processes using a data-driven approach using tools such as Value Stream Mapping/ Process Mapping/ Line Balancing techniques

 Be badass and make an impact to the warehouse team. Value incremental improvements and push them to the floor as quickly as possible. Then iterate until we reach a world-class level.

 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 Bachelor’s degree in engineering 

 12+ years of experience in a high-rate supply chain or manufacturing environment, where complex mechanical and/or electrical assemblies are built with heavy data utilization

 Ability to read technical documentation such as drawings and CAD data, understanding of a variety of hardware manufacturing processes for both electronics (PCBAs, sensor hardware, etc.) and structures, mechanical components, and electromechanical systems

 Ability to travel up to 25% of the time

 Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA

 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 Experience with using Siemens Plant Simulation, Visual Components, or Process Simulation software to model a production line and run production scenarios

 Experience with department or factory design and set up - value stream mapping, flow lines, continuous flow, one piece flow, workstation design

 Ability to completely own a value chain from start to finish, measuring each step of the process, creating actionable tasks that culminated in a significant and sustainable business improvement

 Demonstrated ability of presenting project results to a cross functional team with clearly relating data to proposed next steps

 Prior experience with a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) for production operations or Warehouse Management System (WMS)

 Prior knowledge of NetSuite, Oracle or a similar Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system

 Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing principles which drive manufacturing productivity

 Experience in delivering successful project by being hands on with the process. Including gemba walks, operational analysis, poka yoke solutions among others to allow teams to be successful without massive CAPEX

 Experience interacting with SQL databases - storage of information and building custom queries for tracking production and inventory-related metrics

 US Salary Range
 $183,000 — $243,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

 

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


 

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ . 

 

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

card.description:
**Summary:** The Director, Train System Ops- NY is a leadership role responsible for overseeing structural planning 
for train operations and will determine planning initiatives to support strategic goals. The incumbent will 
conduct analysis of methods to improve operational objectives and enhance procedures to deliver more 
effective outcomes. This position is responsible for developing and implementing strategies to optimize 
system performance in partnership with Amtrak management to improve operational efficiency. It will also 
collaborate with other departments and stakeholders to align system operations with business objectives 
and drive continuous improvement initiatives across NJTRO. The Director, Train System Ops- NY 
requires a strong technical foundation, excellent leadership abilities, and the critical skill of effectively 
managing and prioritizing resources.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Act as liaison with Amtrak regarding emergency decisions and ensure quality assurance

measures are being implemented to benefit NJ TRANSIT Rail Operations.

* Analyzes problems, identifying alternative solutions, projecting consequences of proposed actions

in partnership with Amtrak management to minimize the impact to NJ TRANSITs on time 
performance.

* Perform a variety of routine and complex administrative, supervisory, and professional

responsibilities in providing customer focused, real -time public messaging for emergency and 
non-emergency events in coordination with Amtrak.

* Develop and implement long-term and short-term strategic plans for NJ TRANSIT systems,

aligning with the NJ TRANSIT’s Rail Operation’s goals. 

* Prepare and present reports on the on-time performance of the Northeast Corridor (NEC) and NY

Pennsylvania Station operations.

* Coordinate and attend weekly and monthly meetings with Amtrak management to ensure that

track outages do not impact NJT passenger service and ensure NJT services are protected 
during service disruptions on Amtrak territory.

**This Position Supervises:**

* New York (NY) Public Address Announcer
* Senior Manager, Train Operations
* Supervisor, Train Operations

**Education, Experience and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree (equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of formal

education) 

* Ten (10) years progressive managerial experience in rail operations with emphasis on train

movements, traffic control, dispatching, rail operating management of high-density railroad control 
systems.

**Knowledge and Skills:**

* Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance manuals,

technical and procedure manuals, ordinances and policies, laws, rules and regulations. 

* Ability to prepare reports and correspondence, maintain record and complete forms.
* Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with public safety officials,
* employees, supervisors, and the public.

**Working Environment:**

* Office and/or field

**At NJ Transit you will enjoy a competitive salary and excellent benefits package:**

* Comprehensive Family Health Insurance – Medical, Prescription, Dental, Vision
* Flexible Spending Account
* Life Insurance
* Paid Leave
* Tuition Assistance
* Pre-Tax Commuter Benefits Plan
* Retirement Plans:

 + 401(a) - Retirement plan with a 6% employer contribution
 + 401(k) - Retirement saving plan with up to an 3% company match
 + 457(b) - Deferred Savings Plan

**NJ TRANSIT is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

card.title: Senior Director of Operations
card.description:
The Senior Director of Operations oversees all aspects of operations and provides leadership to the plant managers across multiple sites in a campus environment. Overall responsibility for Production, Maintenance, Personnel Scheduling, and Safety, as well as associated responsibilities in Warehouse Operations, Quality Assurance, Human Resources, Commercialization and other related areas. The Director of Operations is also responsible for establishing the campus culture, servicing business needs, and the 3-year masterplan that delivers all KPIs of Safety, Quality, Customer Service and Cost control.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Direct and oversee ongoing performance and efficiency of all plant functions through the establishment and monitoring of KPI's that seek to meet and/or exceed corporate objectives.
* Develop and mentor plant teams, future leaders, and succession planning by partnering with plant managers and human resources.
* Responsible for strategy development based on customer support, OpEx, return on capital, transformational goals, increasing capacity and throughput and cost discipline.
* Formulates and implements manufacturing programs to maintain and improve the competitive position and profitability of the operations. Set structure and discipline in daily management and utilizing data and KPI's to drive priorities and decisions.
* Sets Fiscal Year and 90-day priorities for the plants.
* Rapidly communicate to Vice President of Operations any significant challenges or failures that may pose a risk to the business.
* Leads the development and implementation of TPM strategies that maximize operational effectiveness/performance while partnering with other divisions to develop actionable plans to improve overall operational effectiveness.
* Develop and implement strategies to drive continuous improvement in safety, productivity, product quality, customer service, quality of work life, and lowering manufacturing costs.
* Works closely with sales and finance teams to ensure seamless start-ups of new products on-time and at optimized costs.
* Role models ownership, collaboration, and disciplined execution.
* Provides support and guidance in the management of product quality and ensures compliance with quality and sanitation policies, procedures, and systems to include HACCP, GMPs and the management and reduction of consumer complaints.
* Ensures all performance issues are addressed in a timely manner and all employees adhere to company policies and procedures on an ongoing basis.
* Ensure compliance with all FDA, OSHA, local regulatory agencies and auditing requirements.

Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or manufacturing or related field of study.
* Experience with plant transformation including organizational design, facility enhancement and upskilling and development of the workforce. Track record of delivering significant business KPI goals in turnaround opportunities.
* Proven leadership skills to put employees first, ability to remove barriers and promote succession planning
* Directly supervise a team of leaders who supervise leaders.
* Able to simply and effectively communicate complex issues up, down and across the organization.
* High degree of financial acumen is required with the ability to perform plant-level financial analysis.
* Self-motivated with excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Computer skills including MS Office programs such as Outlook, Word, Excel PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical / problem solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to empower, motivate and inspire staff.
* Ability to lead change and execute strategic decisions.

**Preferred:**

* MBA preferred, but not required
* TPM, TQM, IWS, Six Sigma, or Lean Manufacturing experience
* Organizational Performance Design capability

**Work Environment:**

* This position works in both office AND manufacturing floor environments.
* Evening and weekend work may be required on an as needed basis
* Travel up to 30%

*Tandem Foods is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

 
 
Compensation: $201,500.00 - $277,000.00

card.description:
Description

**Fairhaven Christian Retirement Center**

This is a leadership role for someone who enjoys managing people, solving problems, improving facilities, and serving seniors in a faith-based community.

**Essential Functions:**

Maintains responsibility for the ongoing, effective, efficient, and cost-effective maintenance of the building, utilities, grounds, and equipment, in addition to the ongoing, effective operation of the maintenance department. This includes supervising, coordination with other departments, assessing and improving department activities.

* Manages and oversees the security function.
* Plans, budgets, schedules, and oversees approved facility modifications and improvements.
* Oversees duplex improvements as agreed with Administration and incoming duplex residents and routine maintenance as determined to be in Fairhaven’s and the residents’ best interest.
* Develops and administers department goals and annual budget.
* Performs supervisory functions including planning, coordinating, organizing, and directing staff, department advocate, performance appraisals, disciplines, staff development, new employee orientation, on-going employee training, conducting staff meetings and other events to foster good communications and strengthen employee morale.
* Oversees and is responsible for maintenance, care and safe use of Fairhaven tools, vehicles, furnishings, supplies and equipment in accordance with policies and procedures.
* Completes all assigned duties and tasks, on or under budget, in a timely fashion.
* Assists in the computer system maintenance and operation as requested.
* Participates on Safety Committee
* Identifies safety hazards and emergency situations and initiates corrective action.
* Prepares and presents training sessions, including in-services on fire safety & emergency preparedness.

**Support Services**

* Supervises Support Services and provides guidance and direction on issues related to the Laundry and Housekeeping Departments, including personnel issues.
* Assists in the preparation of and approves budget relating to Support Services departments. Ensures departments operate within established budget.
* Works with Support Services Manager to develop a capital plan for Fairhaven’s and Support Services’ needs.
* Reviews and approves invoices from vendors related to housekeeping and laundry expenses.

**Regulatory Compliance**

* Complies with all building codes and is the primary contact for building inspections.
* Develops and maintains knowledge of and adherence to the state and federal rules and regulations governing facility requirements for the different levels of care offered at Fairhaven.
* Assures the Maintenance staff’s compliance with IDPH and OSHA regulations.
* Oversees the accuracy, development, and maintenance of EOP procedures. Facilitates EOP drills and staff training.

**Development**

* Recommends development of physical facilities and upgrading of equipment (capital expenditures).
* Keeps up to date on information and technology affecting functional areas to increase innovation and ensure compliance.
* Identifies ways to ensure that the building and grounds are used in accordance with Fairhaven’s religious mission and values and provides its residents with a Christian atmosphere.

**Financial**

* Maintains budgetary and financial control and saves costs where possible.
* Monitors inventory and orders supplies as needed.
* Assesses the price and quality of products and services on a regular basis to ensure Fairhaven is receiving the best available value. Interviews vendors and solicits competing bids on major purchases. Uses good judgment on outsourcing of work to vendors versus appropriate self-performing by Fairhaven staff.

**Essential Qualifications & Requirements:**

* Physical condition allowing for administrative duties including but not limited to sitting, reaching, grabbing, walking the entire facility, use of arms and hands.
* Mechanical aptitude with minimal diagnostic and trouble-shooting skills and common sense; ability to read labels, regulations, technical procedures, professional journals.
* Computer knowledge necessary to perform duties.
* Ability to promptly and courteously handle employee and resident concerns, complaints, work requests, and issues.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks at one time and adapt to a quickly changing environment.
* Familiarity with all current state and federal safety regulations.
* Ability to use reasonable prudent judgment in the problem-solving and decision-making process.
* Ability to communicate (speak, read, and write) effectively in a friendly manner to staff, residents, and the general public in English.
* Excellent interpretive and analytical skills.
* Understanding of and in complete agreement with Fairhaven’s mission statement and core values
* Comfort in a Christian Retirement Center environment.

**Experience & Education or skills preferred:**

* Bachelor’s degree in facility management, business, or engineering and / or five or more years of experience supervising facility operations, leading facility upgrades via planned construction phases or a progressive experience and responsibility in supervising a multi-function facility operation.
* Knowledge of OSHA and IDPH requirements

**Working Conditions:**

* Exposed to a variety of environments inside and outside the facility.

Pay: $80,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance

Work Location: In person

card.description:
Explore opportunities with Kelsey-Seybold Clinic, part of the Optum family of businesses. Work with one of the nation's leading health care organizations and build your career at one of our 40+ locations throughout Houston. Be part of a team that is nationally recognized for delivering coordinated and accountable care. As a multi-specialty clinic, we offer care from more than 900 medical providers in 65 medical specialties. Take on a rewarding opportunity to help drive higher quality, higher patient satisfaction and lower total costs. Join us and discover the meaning behind **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Provides strategic direction, operational leadership, and accountability for health plan enrollment, eligibility for capitated lines of business, health plan premium billing, Medicare and Commercial appeals and grievances and provider disputes, Managed Care Operations mail and fax data intake, and operational reporting and compliance
* Leads managers and operational teams in establishing and executing departmental strategies, performance standards, staffing plans, budgets, and system improvements to deliver accurate, timely, and efficient service to members, providers, and internal stakeholders
* Oversees the development, review, and implementation of department policies, internal controls, quality programs, and corrective actions to meet applicable regulatory and contractual requirements and participates in Health Plan Compliance Committee meetings
* Collaborates with health plan and clinic leadership, Medical Directors, Compliance, Member Services, Claims, Network Development, Sales, Finance, Information Technology, and delegated entities to resolve operational risks, improve service outcomes, and support organizational goals

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of progressive health plan or managed care operations experience, including leadership of Leads, Supervisors or Managers or multiple departments. Experience with enrollment, eligibility, appeals and grievances, provider disputes, regulatory reporting, and compliance
* Experience with Medicare Advantage and Commercial operations, regulatory audits, project management, system enhancements, and process improvement
* Proven solid leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage budgets, develop policies, present in compliance meetings, and lead multiple operational priorities
* Experience with operational dashboards, automation, and quality improvement
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office
* Experience with EPIC, health plan operational systems, and reporting tools

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $112,700 - $193,200 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. Together, we are shaping the future of healthcare by harnessing technology and innovation to make care simpler to navigate, more affordable and more connected for the people we serve. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, valued, heard and respected, empowering people to bring their authentic selves to work and strengthening our collective impact through diverse talents, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.*

*UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.*

*UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are a drug-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.*
